name: opening_range_breakout_30_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY and BANKNIFTY spend the first 30 minutes (09:15-09:45 IST) absorbing overnight positioning, gap adjustments, and the first wave of institutional TWAP/VWAP flow. By 09:45, these forces are largely exhausted and the resulting OR high/low represents a genuine equilibrium boundary — wider and more robust than the 20-minute ORB because it absorbs the early retail momentum flushes too. When NIFTY/BANKNIFTY closes 3 consecutive 5-second bars above the OR high with above-average volume and price above VWAP, the supply ceiling has been systematically consumed by institutional buy-side flow, not spiked through by a single block. At 5-second resolution we enter within 15 seconds of confirmed breakout, capturing the initial 15-25 spot point directional thrust before the move extends into the next resistance zone or stalls.

indicators.name: OR30_high
indicators.purpose: Fixed time window 09:15-09:45 = 360 bars at 5s. NOT scaled — the same 30-minute window regardless of bar size. This is the supply ceiling that must be breached for bullish breakout signal.

indicators.name: OR30_low
indicators.purpose: Fixed time window 09:15-09:45 = 360 bars at 5s. The demand floor for bearish breakout. Together with OR30_high defines the equilibrium zone.

indicators.name: OR30_avg_vol
indicators.purpose: Mean bar volume during the OR period. Used as baseline — breakout bar must exceed 2x this to confirm institutional participation rather than thin-book noise.

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume) from session open
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP from 09:15 IST — no scaling needed. Price above VWAP for bullish breakout confirms that the breakout aligns with intraday institutional benchmark flow direction.

indicators.name: persistence_3bar
indicators.formula: close[i] AND close[i-1] AND close[i-2] all above OR30_high
indicators.purpose: 3 bars = 15 seconds of sustained close above OR boundary. Adapted from original's 2 × 1-min confirmation. 2-min (24 bars) would be too slow for a 30-90s hold; 3 bars (15s) filters 5-second spikes while remaining fast enough to enter before the full thrust completes.

conditions: first bullish breakout of the day only (no re-breakouts)
buy_ce.confirmation: Third consecutive 5-second bar close above OR30_high triggers entry on that bar's close

conditions: first bearish breakout of the day only (no re-breakouts)
buy_pe.confirmation: Third consecutive 5-second bar close below OR30_low triggers entry on that bar's close

entry.entry_price: limit order at bar close (candle close execution)

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option points = ~10 spot points at delta 0.5. ORB throwbacks on NIFTY/BANKNIFTY typically retrace 8-12 spot points to the breakout level before continuing; beyond 10 spot points the breakout has failed and the OR acts as resistance again. Wider than scalp strategies because ORB needs room for the initial throwback.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option points = ~16 spot points at delta 0.5. The initial NIFTY/BANKNIFTY directional thrust after a confirmed 30-min ORB covers 15-25 spot points in the first 30-90 seconds (1:1.6 R:R). Targeting the lower half of expected move gives high hit rate while still clearing costs at scale.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX between 12-28 — below 12 the OR range is too tight for reliable breakouts; above 28 breakouts become noise with excessive gaps
filters.time_filter: Entry only after 09:45 IST (585 min); no new entries after 15:20 IST (920 min)
filters.volume_filter: Breakout bar volume > 2.0x mean OR-period bar volume
filters.trend_filter: VWAP alignment — breakout must be in same direction as price-vs-VWAP
filters.spread_filter: OR30_range must be 0.2%-3.0% of price; too tight = noise, too wide = range day
other_filters: First breakout per direction per day only — second breakout attempts are unreliable

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — 30-min ORB is less crowded than 15-min ORB; but index options add delta decay pressure on time stops

adaptation_notes: Original strategy: 30-min ORB on NIFTY100 stocks, 1-min bars, 2-bar confirmation, hold 30-120 min. Key changes: (1) Moved to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index (smoother, more liquid, institutional-driven — better for ORB because no stock-specific gaps or news distortions). (2) Compressed hold from 30-120 min to 30-90s — we trade the FAST initial thrust, not the full measured move. (3) 2 × 1-min confirmation adapted to 3 × 5-second bars (15s) — short enough to enter before the full thrust, long enough to filter 5s spikes. (4) Stock volume filter (2.5x OR avg) kept at 2.0x because index volume is noisier with continuous futures arbitrage flow. (5) VIX filter widened from 14-25 to 12-28 because index ORB is more robust to volatility than individual stocks. (6) Trailing stop removed — too complex for 30-90s holds; time_stop_bars=18 (90s) replaces it.
weaknesses: First breakout only rule means 1-2 signals per day maximum — low signal count requires high accuracy
3-bar persistence (15s) can still miss 10-15% of the initial breakout move on very fast thrusts
On large gap days (>1.5%), OR30 range may be too wide (>3.0%) and no signal fires — strategy sits out high-volatility events
BANKNIFTY OR30 range tends to be wider than NIFTY, making the 0.2-3.0% filter asymmetric
